newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain unemployment fell to 21.17 pct in March-May.
newsitem.headline: Spain unemployment fell to 21.17 pct in March-May.

text.p: Spanish unemployment from March to May 1997 fell 0.20 points to 21.17 percent, the National Statistics Institute INE said on Monday.
The data is based on an INE survey, completed on a quarterly rolling basis.
INE added that the number of jobless fell 1.04 percent from the previous February to April period to 3.397 million.
The unemployment rate stands at 28.35 percent for women and at 16.63 percent for men.
The total number of employed rose 0.14 percent to 12.651 million.
